meaning:
πιστόω, -ῶ
(πιστός), [in LXX chiefly for אָמֵן ni. ;]
to make trustworthy (Thuc., 3Ki.1:36), hence, to establish (1Ch.17:14). Pass. and mid., to be assured of: with accusative of thing(s), 2Ti.3:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
